name: Destructive actions with Condition + NotResource (boundary)
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION Condition + NotResource cells in one witness. ec2:TerminateInstances + s3:DeleteBucket on NotResource (everything except one bucket) with a StringEquals region Condition. The destructive capability still fires (a Condition narrows when/where, it does not remove the grant); NotResource makes the scope broad, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE fires and is subsumed into DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION in the table.
